mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome to this journey—one where we’ll tackle the wild ride of life, not by pretending it’s easy, but by owning the messy, hilarious, and sometimes scary parts together. If you’ve ever wondered how to face your fears, laugh even when things feel dark, or stand up for yourself when the world seems determined to test your limits, you’re in just the right place. Stay Sexy & Don't Get Murdered: The Definitive How-To Guide by Karen Kilgariff is more than a handbook—it’s a real, raw conversation about surviving and thriving, told through stories that are equal parts witty and wise. We’re going to explore why trusting your gut matters, how boundaries can be your best friend, and what it looks like to actually learn from your past—without beating yourself up. Along the way, we’ll find out how a little humor and honesty can help us stay strong, even when life throws its toughest challenges our way. Together, let’s discover how embracing vulnerability can lead to resilience, how self-acceptance fuels courage, and why it’s so important to put your own well-being first. So, get ready to laugh, reflect, and maybe even see yourself—and your story—in a whole new light.
